description:
About Lodestar

 Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit. Our flagship product   MITHRIL   is the critical hardware & software necessary to augment any off-the-shelf spacecraft with the ability to autonomously detect, characterise, and reversibly neutralise orbital threats. By building on the proven space heritage of our best-in-class satellite-bus partners and fully integrating   MITHRIL   as a single platform, we deliver a fully autonomous end-to-end protection spacecraft service.

 
 About the Job 

  

 As a Payload Engineer I at Lodestar, you'll join the payload team as a primary delivery engineer, taking the payload from laboratory breadboard to qualified engineering model.

 You'll help design, build, integrate and test the payload across optics, mechanical, avionics and software. Working alongside senior systems, GNC, electronics and optics engineers, you'll take the engineering model through design reviews, integration and qualification.

 This is an early-career role with a deliberately broad scope. We're looking for hands-on building experience and fast learning rather than a long track record, and you'll own the engineering model from day one with the support to grow into it.

 We proudly have an "extreme ownership" oriented engineering culture.

 
 What You’ll Do 

 
 Own the payload engineering model day-to-day, end-to-end: requirements, design, build, integration, test, and write-up

 Develop payload, autonomy, effector, power, thermal, and pointing requirements, and the ICDs between payload, avionics, and spacecraft bus

 Prepare SRR, PDR and CDR packages, and keep the verification matrix and risk register current between reviews

 Carry out performance verification and feed corrective design iterations back into the build

 Run hardware-in-the-loop testing at internal & external testing facilities, closing the loop from perception through to pointing against simulated orbital targets

 Support environmental qualification (TVAC, launch vibration, EMC/EMI), including pre-and post-test functional testing and the anomaly and corrective-action trail

 Deliver an end-to-end ground demonstration on a payload-in-the-loop testbed

 Produce technical documentation: test reports, qualification records, and performance assessments against requirements

 
 
 Basic Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Physics, Optics or Photonics, Robotics, Computer Science, or demonstrated equivalent knowledge

 0-2 years of professional experience. Early-career candidates, including recent graduates, are encouraged to apply

 Hands-on evidence of building something real and making it work, such as a university cubesat or rocketry team, research lab, Formula Student, a hardware internship, or a project taken from nothing to working. We weight this far far above grades

 Working proficiency in Python

 
 
 Preferred Skills & Experience 

 
 Space exposure in any form: CubeSat program, hosted payload, space or defense internship, or a space-focused Master's project

 Optics and photonics bench work

 Computer vision

 Closed-loop pointing and control

 End-to-end Environmental test and AIT experience 

 Systems engineering practice

 Embedded or real-time software

 
 
 ITAR Requirements

 To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR   here . 

 
 Compensation & Benefits 

 
 Pay Range for this role:
 
 (P1) Entry: $99,000 - $133,000 / year

 


 
 
 Meaningful equity incentives as part of our employee option pool

 Flexible PTO with generous paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

 Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage

 401(k) retirement plan with company match

 
 
 Additional Information

 Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the   form of stock options   , and access to   medical, vision and dental coverage , as well as   access to a 401(k) retirement plan . 

 Lodestar is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Lodestar is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
